plan: The dominant strategy in this auction is to bid 50% of your value. This minimizes the risk of overpaying and maximizes expected profit. Bidding less risks losing to a slightly higher bid, while bidding more risks overpaying. Given my value is $8, 50% is $4. I will adhere to this strategy, as there is no prior round history to adjust for.
